generation_manifest.oracle: FFprobe demux/decode PTS and FFmpeg coded RGBA SHA256; independent of VLC. FFmpeg shares the generation toolchain: this is not an independent FFmpeg correctness proof. Display PNGs apply autorotation and SAR; scaler/color differences prohibit exact cross-decoder hash acceptance.

initial_failed_attempt.failure: FFmpeg8.0 output rotate metadata tag did not write a display matrix; post-generation validation rejected it
initial_failed_attempt.decision: Use documented input -display_rotation90 with streamcopy; local ffprobe experiment confirmed90degree side data; fresh full run passed

limitations: FFmpeg generation and oracle share a toolchain; independent of VLC but not independent FFmpeg correctness proof
Cross-decoder colorspace/scaler differences mean RGBA hash mismatch alone is not wrong-frame proof
Only FFmpeg/ffprobe8.0 on current host validated; no VLC preparser/nativeUI/performance result from fixture generation
300MiB/1GiB checks are polled working bounds, not OS hard quotas; command/file caps also apply
No font/media assets copied; codec patent/binary redistribution assessment remains separate
